title: CFA Program Level III review: portfolio management and wealth planning
audience: a finance graduate or career changer preparing for the CFA Program exams and a career in investment analysis
purpose: Review the CFA Program Level III core (asset allocation, portfolio construction, performance measurement, derivatives and risk management, and ethics) and the three specialized pathways (portfolio management, private markets and private wealth), practicing both item sets and constructed-response answers.
primary_reading: CFA Institute: CFA Program overview and exam information

weeks.6: Trading, performance evaluation and manager selection
weeks.7: Private wealth: individual clients and taxes
weeks.9: Pathway topics: private markets and portfolio management
weeks.10: Ethics and GIPS at Level III

blocks.deliverable: Build an allocation for an institutional client.
Answer a constructed-response question on a bond portfolio.
Design an overlay with futures and options.
Week 7 midterm; write answers to a full client case.
Take a full-length timed practice exam.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Client case portfolio: write three original client cases (an individual, an institution and a private-markets allocation) with full constructed-response answers, take a full-length timed practice exam, and keep an error log with a final review plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
